newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX and PSE set new options listings.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX and PSE set new options listings.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) and the American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Monday they would begin trading options on Ingram Micro Inc on February 10.
The AMEX also said it would list options on New Holland NV on February 10 and the Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said it would begin trading options on Micro Linear Corp on February 6.
Ingram Micro options would have opening strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2, with initial expirations in February, March, June and September.
The AMEX set position limits at 10,500 contracts.
At the CBOE, the options would trade in the Chrysler Corp trading crowd. Spear, Leeds & Kellogg has been named the specialist for the options at the AMEX.
For New Holland options, opening strikes have been set at 20, 22-1/2 and 25 and initial expirations in February, March, June and September.
Susquehanna Investment Group will be the specialist.
At the PSE, Micro Linear options would open with strike prices of 10, 12-1/2 and 15, with expirations in March, April, July and October. Position limits have been set at 4,500 contracts.
The options have been allocated to pit representative James Burleson in the Octel Communications Corp trading crowd.
